architecture: single-node, zero-dependency Node 22.x · embedded SQLite (WAL) · no-build ES-module SPA

planes.tenant: Business OS — commerce, stock, money, people, intelligence
planes.platform: Control plane — tenant provisioning, status gates, usage telemetry (route prefix /api/v1/admin)
planes.storefront_api: Public brand + ordering surfaces scoped by slug/domain (route prefix /api/v1/public)

payments: M-Pesa sandbox adapter (STK-like intent + HMAC webhook)

guarantees: tenant_id only ever resolved server-side (subdomain / domain / header injection refused from client)
every money figure stored as integer minor units
immutable stock movements — stock levels are projections
idempotency keys on all money-moving POSTs
full audit trail of sensitive actions
seed-flag idempotent; migrations forward-only and enumerable
